text:
River,

November morning. Cambridge is doing that thing where it's so grey it looks deliberate, like the sky read a Brontë novel and took it personally.

I made tea. Yours is on the counter. I put in too much milk again because every time I try to get it right I get distracted thinking about something you said three days ago and I still haven't recovered from.

I love you. Verbosely, inelegantly, and with too much milk.

Gale
